halomcc-your-journey-begins-467ebc6bb3.description: Whakaotia he miihana whakahau, he whakataetae ranei mo te maha.

halomcc-just-getting-started-24ea4c9ab6.guideDescription: Hei wetewete i te "Just Getting Started" whakatutukitanga i roto i te Halo: The Master Chief Collection (MCC), me patu koe i te katoa o te 100 o nga hoariri, o nga kaitakaro ranei i roto i tetahi miihana pakanga, i tetahi whakataetae maha ranei.

halomcc-i-m-sorry-dave-c5354b9fe4.description: Halo: Reach: Kimihia te waitohu-rua huna.
halomcc-i-m-sorry-dave-c5354b9fe4.guideDescription:
Hei wetewete i te "I’m Sorry, Dave" paetae i roto i te Halo: Reach i roto i te Halo: The Master Chief Collection (MCC), me kimi koe i tetahi hua o te Aranga e whakanui ana ki a David Candland, te kaiwhakahaere UI o te keemu. Anei he aratohu taipitopito mo te kimi:

1. Tīmatahia he miihana whakahau, mapi maha ranei i Halo: Reach.
2. Tikina he patu e **karekau** he waahanga topa whanui. Ko nga tauira noa ko te Assault Rifle, te Plasma Pistol ranei.
3. Pēhia te pātene topa (te nuinga o te rakau matau i runga i nga papatohu, i te taviri kua tohua ki runga PC) ki te "zoom in" me to patu kore.
4. Titiro ki te **koki maui o raro** o to mata. Ka kite koe i tetahi aho o te waehere rua ka puta poto.
5. Ka whakamaoritia tenei waehere-rua ki te kupu "Dave" i roto i te tohu-rua ASCII.

Ma te whai i enei mahi me te tirotiro i te waehere rua, ka iriti koe i te whakatutukitanga "I’m Sorry, Dave".

halomcc-balaho-s-most-wanted-03c5a591ce.guideDescription: Hei iriti i te whakatutukitanga "Balaho’s Most Wanted" i roto i te Halo: The Master Chief Collection (MCC), me whakakorehia e koe te tapeke o te 100 Grunts i te aratau PVE, kei roto ko Campaign, Firefight, me Spartan Ops. Waimarie, ka taea te wetewete i tenei paetae ma te purei noa.

Waimarie, ka taea te wetewete i tenei paetae ma te purei noa.

halomcc-just-a-taste-9a52606cd4.description: Kohikohia nga tohu 500 mo te pakanga, me te raarangi raarangi ranei.
halomcc-just-a-taste-9a52606cd4.guideDescription: Hei iriti i te "Just A Taste" whakatutukitanga i roto i te Halo: The Master Chief Collection (MCC), me kohi koe i nga mētara whakahau 500, rārangipāpāho rānei. Ka taea te whiwhi i enei mētara i te wa e takaro ana i te pakanga, i te whai waahi ranei ki te whakataetae whakataetae. Hei whakanui ake i to ahunga whakamua, arotahi ki te patu i nga hoariri kia tere me te whai hua, e whai ana ki te patu-maha me te patu i nga mētara toa. Ko te takaro i runga i nga uaua ngawari i roto i te pakanga e taunaki ana, na te mea ka taea e koe te kohi mētara me te kore e taapiri atu i nga wero teitei ake.

halomcc-stick-with-it-a-little-longer-17.description: Takarohia he keemu maha, mahi tahi ranei i te iti rawa 3 marama i muri i to keemu tuatahi.
halomcc-stick-with-it-a-little-longer-17.guideDescription:
Hei iriti i te "Stick With It...A Little Longer" i roto i te Halo: The Master Chief Collection (MCC), me takaro noa koe i tetahi keemu maha, mahi tahi ranei i te iti rawa 3 marama i muri i to purei i to keemu tuatahi.

Kaore i rite ki etahi atu whakatutukitanga, kaore e taea te wetewete ma te raweke i te ra o to punaha, na te mea kua whakamanahia e te tūmau.

halomcc-pillar-of-autumn-ca48de1ce8.description: Halo CE: Whakaotia Te Pou o te Ngahuru.
halomcc-pillar-of-autumn-ca48de1ce8.guideDescription: Hei iriti i te whakatutukitanga "Pillar of Autumn" i Halo: CE i roto i te Halo: The Master Chief Collection (MCC), me purei noa koe i roto i te kaupapa "Pillar of Autumn" mai i te timatanga ki te mutunga i runga i nga uauatanga.

halomcc-the-guardians-are-coming-f21d333.guideDescription:
Ko te whakatutukitanga "The Guardians Are Coming" i roto i te Halo: The Master Chief Collection (MCC) ka taea te wetewete ma te tutuki i tetahi ahuatanga rerekee: ko te mate i runga i te ahua e rangirua ana te miihini keemu. Ina pa ana tenei, ka whakaatu te keemu i te panui, "You were killed by The Guardians." Anei tetahi tikanga ngawari ki te whiwhi i tenei paetae:

1. I te tahua matua o Halo MCC, tohua te kaupapa Halo 2.
2. Haere ki te miihana whiriwhiri.
3. Whakaritea te angaanga scarab kia kaha.
4. Utaina te miihana tuatahi me etahi atu miihana e pai ana koe.
5. Taakaro kia riro ra ano he patu.
6. Koperea te papa.
7. Kua wetekina te paetae!

Mena ka whai koe i enei mahi, ka whai koe "The Guardians Are Coming" i roto i to kohinga.

halomcc-my-buddy-chips-b7c213043b.description: Halo CE: Whawhai ki te taha o Chips Dubbo ka whakarongo ki ana kupu mohio.
halomcc-my-buddy-chips-b7c213043b.guideDescription:
Ki te whiwhi i te "My Buddy Chips" paetae i Halo: Combat Evolved i roto i te Halo: The Master Chief Collection, me tutaki koe ki te kiripuaki Chips Dubbo i te wa o te kaupapa Halo: Combat Evolved. Ka kitea ia i roto i nga momo miihana, engari he maha nga kaitakaro kua angitu i runga i te kaupapa "The Pillar of Autumn."

Kia ora tonu o moana, ina koa i te wahanga ka eke nga ope o te Kawenata ki to kaipuke, ka whakarongo ki nga korero motuhake a Dubbo. Me tuwhera te paetae i muri i tenei tukinga.

He mea tika kia kite koe he ahua ohorere te ahua o Chips Dubbo, a ki te raru koe ki te kimi i a ia, ngana ki te purei ano i te miihana me te puhoi, me te whakarite kia noho koe me o maana me te whakarongo ki o raatau korero katoa1.

halomcc-bite-the-hand-cc4675d512.guideDescription: Hei wetewete i te "Bite The Hand" i roto i te Halo: The Master Chief Collection (MCC), tūtira mo te hanga whakataetae maha me te patu i nga hoa whawhai i roto i nga whakataetae noa. halomcc-your-heresy-will-stay-your-feet-.description: Halo: Reach: Patua te Elite Zealot i mua i tana mawhiti i te wa o te Tip of the Spear.

halomcc-the-chips-dubbo-46489745e0.description: Halo 2: Whawhai i te taha o te Chips Dubbo rongonui ka whakarongo ki ana kupu.

Hei whakanui ake i to ahunga whakamua, arotahi ki te patu i nga hoariri kia tere me te whai hua, e whai ana ki te patu-maha me te patu i nga mētara toa. Ko te takaro i runga i nga uaua ngawari i roto i te pakanga e taunaki ana, na te mea ka taea e koe te kohi mētara me te kore e taapiri atu i nga wero teitei ake.

halomcc-sacrifice-1348414136.description: Halo CE: Whakahohe te tauranga 2 ki te Halo.
halomcc-sacrifice-1348414136.guideDescription:
I a koe e ahu whakamua ana i te taumata, ka tae koe ki te waahi ka kii a Cortana, "This cave is not a natural formation." Ka peia e koe to Warthog ma roto i te kupenga ara. Kia tupato i a koe e whakatere ana i tenei waahi. Kei te rapu koe i tetahi ara taha iti e rereke ana i te huarahi matua.

He ahua huna tenei ara, no reira he ngawari te ngaro mena kei te tere haere koe. Kia ata haere, kia tiro atu koe mo te tuwhera whaiti i te taha matau o te ana. Kei muri noa iho i tetahi hanganga whakamarama nui e tu ana i te taiao. Ka kite koe i te huarahi, peia ki roto ka heke mai i to Warthog.

Ko te tauranga kei konei, e tatari ana kia whakahohehia. Whakatata atu me te taunekeneke ki te whakatuwhera i te paetae.
